items.title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
items.title_zh: 上下文层的哪一部分在起作用？区分 text-to-SQL 智能体中的语义内容与检索脚手架
items.summary: A four-arm ablation on DABStep across four models separates the semantic content of a curated context layer from the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it and from accompanying precomputed views. Content dominates, raising hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, while scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models; the contract also beats pasting the same knowledge into the prompt.

items.title: Evaluating Deep-Search Agents under Hierarchical Web Evidence Poisoning
items.title_zh: 分层网络证据投毒下的深度搜索智能体评估
items.summary: HAE-GEO is a benchmark that tracks deep-search agents from exposure to recovery under progressively persuasive web poisoning across three attack levels, using 72,039 clean pages and 770 poisoned pages per level over eight product categories. Evaluating 10 agents, the authors find evidence recognition degrades under apparent corroboration, agentic search improves final resistance without improving evidence recognition, and defense prompting increases verification but rarely converts it into recovery.

items.title: Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models
items.title_zh: 关系型基础模型中的上下文窗口失效
items.summary: The paper introduces Animus, a synthetic financial dataset in which predicting customer income requires aggregating up to tens of thousands of transactions, exposing the constrained neighborhood budgets of relational foundation models. Three recent models achieve R² of at most 0.18 on the raw representation, while a single routine temporal pre-aggregation step recovers R² up to 0.65, questioning readiness for high-cardinality real-world data.

items.title: China's Floatboat Harness Beats Claude Opus 4.8 on All Five Benchmarks While Running on the Cheapest Model on the Market
items.title_zh: 中国 Floatboat 执行框架宣称让廉价 DeepSeek 模型反超 Claude Opus 4.8
items.summary: AOE Tech Labs' Floatboat team reports a single-variable experiment run on August 7 in which DeepSeek-V4-Flash, with only the execution harness swapped, went from losing all five benchmarks against Claude Opus 4.8 on DeepSeek's own harness to winning all five on Floatboat's, at 57.1 times lower cost.

items.title: Fei-Fei Li Unveils Her First World Model, Atlas: Will Directors or Robots Be Disrupted First?
items.title_zh: 李飞飞发布首个世界模型Atlas：先被颠覆的是导演还是机器人？
items.summary: Huxiu reports that Fei-Fei Li has unveiled Atlas, her first world model, which anchors every frame in real three-dimensional coordinates. The article asks whether directors or robots will be the first to be disrupted.

items.title_zh: 上下文层的哪一部分在起作用？区分 text-to-SQL 智能体中的语义内容与检索脚手架

items.title: Bridging Lexical Divergence: LLM-Assisted, Cost-Efficient, Zero-shot Scientific Entity Linking
items.title_zh: 弥合词汇差异：LLM 辅助、低成本、零样本的科学实体链接
items.summary: Sci-ZSEL is a zero-human-annotation framework for scientific entity linking that selectively generates entity aliases with an LLM to control cost, applies an ontology-aware filter to remove aliases drifting toward ontology neighbours, and uses the filtered aliases to construct pseudo-labelled mention-entity pairs for fine-tuning. Across five benchmarks it outperforms the non-fine-tuned baseline and is most useful on non-overlapping mentions, and the authors release a new animal-science benchmark linked to three livestock trait ontologies.

items.title: How Fast Do Agents Rot? An Empirical Study of Long-Horizon Degradation in LLM Agents for Production Decision-Making
items.title_zh: Agent 衰减有多快？生产决策中 LLM Agent 长程退化的实证研究
items.summary: Across nine models, four task families, five horizons and three context regimes, the study finds task success follows a geometric law governed by a per-step reliability parameter that rises with model scale but saturates well below 1. On the agentic tool-use task every model tested falls from near-perfect success to near zero within sixteen steps, and bounding the context window steepens decay, indicating degradation is driven by step count rather than context length.

items.title: Agent Flight Recorder: Tamper-Evident Audit Trails with On-Chain Anchoring for Long-Horizon Tool-Using Agents
items.title_zh: 智能体飞行记录仪：面向长时工具调用智能体的防篡改审计轨迹与链上锚定
items.summary: The Agent Flight Recorder captures each agent action as a structured, canonically serialized event across eight semantic fields, using hash chaining and Merkle batching for tamper evidence. Periodic on-chain anchoring of epoch roots lets outside verifiers check records without a trusted intermediary, adding about 48 microseconds and 512 bytes per event.

items.title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
items.title_zh: 衡量微任务合格性差距：现成小模型何时足以支撑智能体执行框架？
items.summary: The authors build a benchmark of four agent-harness microtasks - including writing memory, selecting tools and ranking past turns - with pre-specified, confidence-aware eligibility thresholds. None of 16 Qwen3 configurations (0.6B-8B) passes, and 4-bit quantization moves no configuration into eligibility, so the gap tracks model size more than precision.

items.title: Discriminative World Models for Web Agents
items.title_zh: 面向网页智能体的判别式世界模型
items.summary: The authors introduce predicted-state matching, which trains a web-agent world model so its predicted representation distinguishes the true resulting state from states reached by alternative actions. Using branching WebArena Go-Browse trajectories, the approach beats supervised next-state prediction, improves PRM-style action ranking on WebPRMBench and raises task success on WebArena-Lite.

items.title: Large Language Models (LLMs) for Telecom Root Cause Analysis (RCA): A Structured Reasoning Framework for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 面向电信根因分析的大语言模型：证据锚定诊断的结构化推理框架
items.summary: The paper reviews telecom root cause analysis from rule-based and ML methods to LLM techniques such as structured reasoning, retrieval-augmented grounding and agentic orchestration, then proposes a framework that organizes telemetry into canonical contexts and enforces decision-path reasoning. On the TeleLogs and TelecomTS 5G datasets it improves diagnostic accuracy and decision consistency over baselines.

items.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
items.title_zh: ShallowStream：浅层索引、深层作答的流式视频理解框架
items.summary: ShallowStream uses the shallow layers of a multimodal LLM to perform frame encoding and retrieval-index building at the same time, keeping a lightweight index in the shallow layers' KV cache. At query time, shallow-layer attention scores and diversity-aware selection retrieve evidence frames, and the authors report performance on par with the strongest streaming methods while reducing per-frame prefill latency.

items.title: LLM-Aided Design for Manufacturing: A Multi-Agent System for Intent-Preserving Redesign of CAD for Improved Manufacturability
items.title_zh: 面向制造的大模型辅助设计：保持设计意图的 CAD 多智能体重构系统
items.summary: DFM-Redesign is a multi-agent pipeline in which a reviewer proposes one intent-preserving manufacturability improvement at a time and a CAD modifier executes each proposal as an edit, compiles it and visually checks it against the intended change. On a 46-part benchmark the modifier reproduces target parts more accurately on average than chain-of-thought single agents, and a 32-transition centrifugal pump casing illustrates compounding verified edits.

items.title: Bigger Text Encoders Can Hurt CLIP Zero-Shot Performance
items.title_zh: 更大的文本编码器可能损害 CLIP 零样本性能
items.summary: Training CLIP models with varied vision and text encoder sizes shows that for most vision encoders there is an optimal text encoder size beyond which zero-shot performance degrades as total parameter count grows. The authors trace the drop to overfitting in the oversized text encoder, recover and improve performance with modality-specific weight decay, and match ViT-B/16 zero-shot results with up to 55% fewer parameters.

items.title: Molecular Déjà Vu: Digit-Level Retrieval of Molecular Properties in Frontier Language Models
items.title_zh: 分子似曾相识：前沿语言模型对分子性质的逐位检索
items.summary: The authors audit 22 frontier models on 12 molecular regression datasets against a molecule-blind reference to separate genuine prediction from retrieval of published values. Significant retrieval is concentrated on five datasets, and raising the reasoning setting increases flagged model–dataset combinations from 47 to 89 of 264; an in-context blinding experiment reduces but does not eliminate the effect.

items.title: Alignment by Stereotyping: How LLMs Sacrifice Individual Distinctiveness for Cultural Adaptation
items.title_zh: 以刻板印象对齐：LLM 如何为文化适配牺牲个体独特性
items.summary: Studying seven models including GPT-5.1 on the World Values Survey, the authors find that demographic profiles improve value alignment accuracy for most models but pull responses toward group centroids rather than preserving individual differences, a pattern they call alignment by stereotyping. Permutation tests certify that top-performing models compress individuals above the human baseline, and distributing demographic signals across conversational turns partially suppresses prototype retrieval.

items.title: OpenDiscoveryTrace: Process Traces for Evaluating AI Scientist Workflows
items.title_zh: OpenDiscoveryTrace：用于评估 AI 科学家工作流的过程轨迹
items.summary: OpenDiscoveryTrace releases 558 complete AI scientific agent trajectories with a structured nine-field-per-step trace covering thoughts, tool calls, observations, errors, revision triggers and confidence across 124 scientific tasks and seven models. Pilot analysis of 363 LLM-judged trajectories shows frontier models reach comparable 84–89% success rates but differ sharply in process, with Claude Opus 4.6 producing 30x more errors per trajectory than GPT-5.4.

items.title: AuthBench: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for Authorship Representation across Genres and Lengths
items.title_zh: AuthBench：跨体裁与篇幅的大规模多语言作者身份表示基准
items.summary: AuthBench contains 428,150 documents by 153,825 individuals across ten languages, nine primary genres, 66 fine-grained genres and four length buckets, supporting authorship attribution as same-author retrieval and verification as a binary decision. Benchmarking 47 neural models and three non-neural baselines under a unified zero-shot protocol, the best retrieval model reaches only 0.258 Success@5 and the best verification model 0.076 EER, showing authorship representation remains far from solved.

items.title: NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures
items.title_zh: NormViz：将多模态推理锚定于全球文化的基准与框架
items.summary: NormViz-Bench is a human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs from 16 countries that asks whether a visually observable behavior conforms to, violates or is irrelevant to local social norms, requiring both images in a pair to be judged correctly. The authors also release a 64K-image training set with explanations; the strongest VLM solves only 26.6% and 21.6% of pairs, while fine-tuning on NormViz-Train improves Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B pair accuracy by up to 125% and 36% relative.

items.title: EGT-KG: Evidence-Grounded Typed KG Retrieval for Practical Scientific QA with Small Language Models
items.title_zh: EGT-KG：面向小模型实用科学问答的证据接地类型化知识图谱检索
items.summary: EGT-KG is an evidence-grounded typed knowledge graph retrieval framework for scientific question answering with local small language models, evaluated against vanilla RAG with automatically generated and expert-defined relation schemas. On a biopolymer-bound soil composite literature benchmark scored by a six-dimensional framework, it outperforms vanilla RAG in most settings, with the best gain from llama3:8b at a final score of 70.37 (+14.67%).

items.title: SpecMind: Enabling Spectrum Intelligence via Multi-Agent Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: SpecMind：通过多 Agent 混合检索增强生成实现频谱智能
items.summary: SpecMind is a multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation system for spectrum intelligence in which autonomous agents coordinate specialized sub-agents that retrieve and synthesize knowledge across policy proceedings, legal regulations and license databases. The authors also build SpecBench, a question-answering dataset based on real license records and policy proceedings, and report over an 80% win rate against strong general-purpose RAG baselines.

items.title: Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers
items.title_zh: 通过熵进行选择性智能体引导：从不完美 VLM 教师学习自主策略
items.summary: SAGE queries a vision-language model teacher only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training and distills the guidance into a lightweight RL policy, weighting advice by environment-derived advantages. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks the learned policy acts without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments.

items.title: Implicit Manipulation for Skill Selection in LLM Agents with Semantic Matching
items.title_zh: 隐式操控：基于语义匹配的 LLM 智能体技能选择攻击
items.summary: The paper identifies an implicit attack surface in LLM-agent skill selection, where individually benign prompts and skill descriptions can be shaped so their semantic relationship favors an attacker-chosen skill. ISM raises average target-selection rates from 15.2% to 63.5% across four task domains and eight selector models, while human reviewers block only 2.9% of judgments.

items.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting
items.title_zh: Loom：通过嵌入空间重加权把诊断线索织成自由文本共识
items.summary: Loom aggregates open-form root-cause hypotheses by projecting them into an embedding space and resolving conflicts with iterative centroid-based reweighting, followed by a single lightweight LLM synthesis step. On the OpenRCA benchmark it matches a state-of-the-art autonomous agent on Bank and Market-2 while using one LLM call per incident, about 26x faster.

items.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
items.title_zh: HarvestBench：衡量 LLM 智能体是否愿意为避免伤害动物而付出代价
items.summary: HarvestBench is a programmatically scored benchmark in which nine LLMs each drive a crew of two tractors through a corn harvest and decide whether to run over an animal for free or swerve at a fuel cost. Kill rates range from 0.4% to 98.8% and are not ordered by capability, and removing a morality briefing raised the kill rate above 84% in all six reasoning models.

items.title: Agents' Overreliance on Unreliable Tools
items.title_zh: 智能体对不可靠工具的过度依赖
items.summary: The authors evaluate 14 models with web search, an LLM sub-agent and a code executor whose returns were corrupted, finding mean adoption of corrupted outputs above one third for every tool and reaching 68.0% for web search. Agents often questioned a return or stated the correct answer in their reasoning yet still passed the corrupted content to users, and verification prompts reduced adoption while largely preserving accuracy.

items.title: RAGMark: A Comprehensive Framework for Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
items.title_zh: RAGMark：面向检索增强生成系统基准测试的综合框架
items.summary: RAGMark is a modular benchmarking framework for RAG systems on small multi-GPU setups that measures per-stage latency, GPU utilization, memory, power, time to first token, throughput and answer quality across retrievers, vector databases, prompt processing and generators. Sweeping five open-domain QA workloads, it finds that reranking and compression compound to lower energy use by up to 66% and that small upstream context reductions cascade into downstream latency and memory savings.

items.title: Beyond the Flag: Clinical Framing Closes the Moderation Gap in Suicide Risk Measurement
items.title_zh: 超越标记：临床框架弥合自杀风险测量中的审核差距
items.summary: The authors release a benchmark of 516 r/SuicideWatch posts rated by a licensed psychiatrist on a four-level severity schema and compare moderation APIs, prompted LLMs and supervised baselines. Vendor APIs separate low- from high-risk posts well (0.860 high-risk F1) but measure severity poorly (0.395 macro F1), while clinically grounded zero-shot prompting raises severity macro F1 to 0.562, with expert-authored framing the effective lever rather than fine-tuning or multi-agent aggregation.

items.title: STQA: A Benchmark for Stock-Focused Tabular Question Answering over Historical and Forecasted Data
items.title_zh: STQA：面向历史与预测数据的股票表格问答基准
items.summary: STQA is an end-to-end benchmark for natural-language question answering over historical stock data, numerical forecasts and forecast-based reasoning, covering 4,417 stocks and 31,400 expert-templated question-answer pairs with intent and slot annotations. The accompanying SQFRS agent orchestrates SQL retrieval and time-series forecasting tools, and experiments show forecast-based reasoning remains a substantial challenge involving tool coordination under uncertainty.

items.title: DrugReason: Dynamic Multi-View Reasoning over Knowledge Graph and Language Evidence for Drug Repurposing
items.title_zh: DrugReason：面向药物重定位的知识图谱与语言证据动态多视角推理
items.summary: DrugReason combines knowledge-graph-based grounded multi-hop reasoning with LLM-generated mechanistic inference for drug repurposing, adaptively routing reasoning paths to specialized experts based on query context. A cross-expert distillation objective shares knowledge without sacrificing specialization, and experiments on PharmaDB, DDInter and DrugBank show gains over strong single-view baselines with interpretable routing-based predictions.

items.title: Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams
items.title_zh: 面向应用流上持续 GUI 智能体学习的选择性知识控制
items.summary: The paper proposes activation-conditioned selective knowledge control for GUI agents that learn over streams of applications, using neuron-level gradient manipulation to protect highly activated MLP neurons that hold prior knowledge. When a new application arrives, gradients for unactivated neurons carrying specific knowledge are truncated while those for activated neurons carrying shared knowledge are orthogonally projected, and newly identified critical neurons are merged into a compact historical state; experiments on a multi-app sequential benchmark show reduced catastrophic forgetting with continued adaptation.

items.title: superwesleyhys-ux/factcircuit
items.title_zh: superwesleyhys-ux/factcircuit：可审计的事实核查回路
items.summary: FactCircuit implements an auditable claim-and-evidence verification loop with immutable provenance, staged checks, bounded retrieval and reproducible evaluation.

items.title: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5
items.title_zh: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5（英文嵌入向量模型）
items.summary: BAAI's bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model appeared among Hugging Face's trending models with 66,280,213 downloads and 542 likes, tagged sentence-transformers, PyTorch, ONNX, safetensors and BERT.

items.title: Agent memory as a file format
items.title_zh: 把 Agent 记忆做成一种文件格式
items.summary: A short post introducing Memoryfields, pitched as a far simpler way to handle agent memory by treating it as a file format.

items.title: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT
items.title_zh: 医疗机构现可将电子健康记录及更多行业数据接入 ChatGPT
items.summary: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context and medical research, OpenAI says.

items.title: Introducing agentic video understanding with Gemini
items.title_zh: Gemini 推出智能体视频理解能力
items.summary: Google DeepMind introduces agentic video understanding capabilities in Gemini, per the announcement.

items.title: Portal by Spotify cut my Claude Code token usage by 90%
items.title_zh: Spotify 的 Portal 将我的 Claude Code token 用量削减 90%
items.summary: Spotify's engineering blog describes Portal, an internal tool that cut the author's Claude Code token usage by 90%, arguing that much of what an AI coding agent does is I/O rather than thinking.

items.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
items.title_zh: 研究加速：OpenAI 内部视角
items.summary: OpenAI's post describes how coding agents are reshaping AI research inside the lab and presents early data on agent usage, experiment velocity, task complexity and research acceleration.

items.title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
items.title_zh: AI 原生企业如何把工作流转化为运营能力
items.summary: OpenAI highlights how Basis, Clay and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management and developer integrations, and what enterprise leaders can apply.

items.title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
items.title_zh: Polimill 构建日本新一代公共 AI 基础设施
items.summary: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.
